code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 4 for x in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j] == 4 for i in range(len(grid)))]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    background = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != 4).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r in range(len(rb)-1):
        line = []
        for c in range(len(cb)-1):
            n = sum(grid[i][j] != background and grid[i][j] != 4 for i in range(rb[r]+1, rb[r+1]) for j in range(cb[c]+1, cb[c+1]))
            line.append(1 if n == 2 else background if n == 1 else 0)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''; open(path,'w').write(code); exec(code); print(transform(g))
